categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes src/bitcoin-cli.cpp, which implements bitcoin-cli explicitly covered by the rpc category.
categories.rationale: Fixes two functional regressions in bitcoin-cli's HTTP client introduced in PR #34342. Responses with Content-Length: 0 caused the client to wait indefinitely for server connection closure, and -rpcclienttimeout prematurely aborted slow or large responses even while data was actively arriving (PR description). Resolving these regressions ensures reliable CLI operation for authentication failures and long-running RPCs without indefinite hangs or aborts.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The tools category explicitly covers command-line tools 'other than the node and its RPC client'.
categories.rationale: Non-member. Changes apply to bitcoin-cli, which is explicitly assigned to RPC and excluded from Tools.
